adaptation_note: The ASP.NET control appears in the source site-not-found state. Laravel preserves its stricter explicit snapshot route resolution: unknown or foreign site IDs fail closed before React renders. The source-equivalent recovery intent is therefore exposed on the real snapshot workspace without weakening the 404/IDOR boundary. The /offline-data route contract is separately owned by canonical operation AIMW-CONT-98918A6C27 (#828); this closure does not alter or claim that route.
